Those [[Aes Sedai]] and other residents of the [[White Tower]] who fled after [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] deposed [[Siuan Sanche]] as the [[Amyrlin Seat]]. While the Tower has been reunified, inclusion in this category will still show who rebeled against the Tower.
